text: Genesys is privately held; Wikipedia lists its owners as the private-equity firms Hellman & Friedman, Permira and Technology Crossover Ventures.
short: Genesys is owned by private-equity firms Hellman & Friedman, Permira and TCV.

source.name: Wikipedia – Genesys (company)
source.quote: In July 2016, private equity investor Hellman & Friedman purchased a $900 million stake in Genesys from majority owners Permira and Technology Crossover Ventures
